publicReleaseNotes:
Pencil 0.4.0 adds Daily response digests, AI rewrites of a draft question that you accept explicitly, in-app analysis notifications, and rer signin owner links for a hosted deployment.

Each operator can now choose Daily for a flow's response email: one digest at the opening of the workspace's sending window, with counts only and never answers. Rewrite this question sends only the saved question, style and context to your configured AI provider, and changes the draft only when you accept the proposal. Analysis notifications list your finished runs on the Analysis page. Sending windows may cross midnight.

Add question no longer reroutes the previous question. A new question leads to your completion screen and stays unconnected until an earlier question's rule or default next screen points to it; Publish refuses an unreachable question.

Privacy: /signin no longer fills in the owner's email for visitors. The field is filled only from a login_hint parameter on a link the owner was given. While analysis is on, the form notice now says that names or emails typed into a selected text answer are sent with that answer.

Upgrading a local install: stop dev, export, pull, then run rer install, rer setup and rer dev. rer dev now applies pending migrations before it serves, and refuses to start, telling you to run rer setup, if it cannot. Migrations 0035 and 0036 are additive. Pencil pins rer 0.2.20; rer deploy --remove is documented, and deployed backups exclude Cloudflare's internal _cf_KV table.

rer demo opens a disposable, signed-in Pencil Demo on sample data, whose mail and third-party effects return success without sending. Local dev reads Pencil Dev and suppresses mail.

No contract clause is deferred. The importers were checked with documented-format synthetic files only, and AI features only against scripted local providers. This release does not claim hosted capacity beyond the measured ceiling or live mail delivery.
agentUpdateInstructions: Read OPERATIONS.md, docs/FIRST-RELEASE.md and docs/HOSTING.md. Export first to a private path outside source paths or in this checkout's ignored exports directory, and verify recovery into a new local database or an explicitly selected empty migrated D1 database. Preserve the documented archive redactions and never restore over existing application records. Preserve every applied migration's bytes, including 0019 as your database applied it (migrations/released-rewrites.json), and apply 0035 and 0036 in order before serving the new source: locally with rer setup (rer dev also applies pending migrations before it serves and refuses with run rer setup when it cannot), and hosted with rer deploy, which applies them in order. Keep SETUP_TOKEN unset after the owner claim. Add question no longer reroutes the previous question: connect a newly added question before publishing. /signin prefills only from login_hint; never reintroduce a lookup of an operator's email for anonymous visitors. AI stays off unless AI_ENABLED and a transport are set; rewrites change a draft only on explicit accept. Never replay historical or imported mail, and Daily digests never resend restored history. Run the populated 0.3.0 predecessor upgrade test and the complete verification gate on the integrated source. No contract clause is deferred.
